name: Herefordshire (United Kingdom)

colors.symbolism: the bull's face and the wavy stripes

description: A red field bearing the head of a Hereford bull (red-brown with the breed's white face) above blue-and-white wavy stripes for the River Wye.
history: Designed by Brady Ells; chosen in a 2019 county-wide poll and registered with the Flag Institute on 26 February 2019. The bull is a reference to the Hereford breed of cattle.

features.role: Hereford bull's head with white face
blue-and-white wavy stripes of the Wye
